video.title: What White Belts Actually Need to Learn in Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu
video.description:
White belt is where you build the habits that either support everything that follows—or make the later belts much harder. In the first episode of The BJJ Belt Journey, I cover my full three-year white-belt story: training volume, weight and strength work, learning defense from upper belts, choosing difficult partners, managing ego, and what competition taught me.

More from Toby on Fitness Tech: https://tobyonfitnesstech.com
